seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: January, March and April. Driest: June, July and August. Hottest: April (26.4°C average). Coolest: August (24.7°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

laws.rule: Christmas Island is an Australian external territory: Commonwealth laws apply unless excluded, and Western Australian laws apply as 'applied laws' unless an Ordinance repeals, suspends or modifies them. No consolidated list of applied laws is published, so check WA law and the territory's Applied Laws Ordinance for a specific rule.
